title: Per-visitor rate limits through the gateways
why: All server-rendered traffic shared one bucket and a browser could choose its own. Trust ranges wider than /8 or /16 are refused.
changelog: The same-origin gateways now forward the client address
steps: Behind nginx or another gateway, set `trustProxy: ['127.0.0.1', '::1']` in `server/platform.jsbrain`.
